subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace `SKILL.md` diagnostics be exposed only through a new validation/lint command, or also through normal skills status/list/check/Web surfaces?
rationale: Current main still silently drops invalid candidates, while the open PR is a plausible implementation but may not cover every user-visible surface requested by this issue.

options.title: Require status/list/check/Web plus lint
options.body: Thread skipped-candidate diagnostics through the shared status model and add a CLI validation command so ordinary discovery and explicit validation both explain missing skills.

options.title: Accept lint-only validation
options.body: Keep normal skills discovery unchanged and land a smaller explicit validation command, accepting that users must know to run it when a skill disappears.

options.title: Pause for a narrower design
options.body: Hold the candidate PR until maintainers define the exact failure schema, redaction behavior, and UI surface before implementation continues.

recommendation.title: Require status/list/check/Web plus lint
recommendation.body: Thread skipped-candidate diagnostics through the shared status model and add a CLI validation command so ordinary discovery and explicit validation both explain missing skills.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership signals cover the loader/status/CLI surfaces where the product-scope decision must be implemented.
